commands.name: twitch role
commands.description:
Set a role to mention for a Twitch stream alert.

This is useful for pinging without a custom message.

commands.name: twitch role remove
commands.description: Remove a role from being mentioned for a Twitch stream alert.

commands.name: twitch add
commands.description: Add a channel to receive stream alerts.

commands.name: twitch message
commands.description:
Set a custom message for a Twitch stream alert.

The following variables are available:
> `{stream}`: The stream.
> `{guild}`: The guild.

commands.name: twitch remove
commands.description: Remove a channel from receiving stream alerts.

commands.name: reposter
commands.description: Fine tune reposters which can be used in your server.

commands.name: reposter disable
commands.description:
Disable a reposter in a specific channel.
If no channel is provided, the reposter will be disabled globally.

commands.name: reposter enable
commands.description:
Enable a reposter in a specific channel.
If no channel is provided, the reposter will be enabled globally.
